name: Lyon
dek: Lyon-Bron, not Lyon-Saint-Exupéry. The two files are not averaged.
paragraphs: Lyon-Bron is WMO 07480, at 202 m. Lyon-Saint-Exupéry, WMO 07481, is a separate complete file in the same submission. Bron is the station on this page. The airport file is not merged with it and is not used to fill a cell.

Bron's winter minimums sit near freezing and the July high is the warm peak. Precipitation is present in every month, with October the heaviest in this file. That is a Rhône station, not the Nice coast and not Montsouris.

climate.caption: Station: Lyon-Bron, WMO 07480. Not Lyon-Saint-Exupéry.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Submitted for France. Saint-Exupéry was not substituted.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and E, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list shows France at 230 volts and 50 hertz, with plug types C and E.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article R412-9 of the Code de la route, in force since 11 January 2025, says that in normal driving every driver must keep the vehicle near the right edge of the carriageway, as far as the state or profile of that carriageway allows. The same article makes exceptions, including a multi-lane roundabout when the exit is to the driver's left, and some cycle movements.
driving.sourceTitle: Code de la route, article R412-9, Légifrance

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: France.fr's money page, which the page itself says was updated on 6 March 2019, says almost all restaurants include tax and a 15% service charge, marked service compris. If the meal was particularly good, it calls another 2–3% customary, or the small change when paying cash. If the bill says service is not included, the same page calls a 15% tip appropriate. It also gives figures for hotels, taxis, and a few other services. Those figures are the page's, and the page has not been updated since 2019.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for France, last reviewed 8 October 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Euro and the code EUR for France.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone1970.tab puts France and Monaco on Europe/Paris, and France has no second row in that file. Paris, Lyon, and Nice are in France.

entry.note: The government's visa portal. We do not restate a visa rule.
